About me

Where creativity
meets craft.

I'm Kanza Safdar, a passionate fashion design student from Khanewal, currently pursuing a BS in Fashion Designing at the University of Southern Punjab, Multan. In my 6th semester, I have developed a strong foundation in both the technical and artistic dimensions of fashion — believing that great design begins where precision meets imagination.

My academic journey has shaped me into a versatile designer with hands-on expertise in draping, sewing, and pattern making, alongside a keen eye for digital sketching, illustration, and textile recognition. I approach every project with discipline, cultural awareness, and a drive to create garments that are not only aesthetically compelling but also technically refined.

Beyond the classroom, I am deeply interested in sustainable fashion practices, trend forecasting, and the fusion of traditional South Asian textile heritage with contemporary silhouettes — bringing a unique perspective to modern fashion design.

What I offer

Designing skills
& expertise.

Digital fashion & details

Creating detailed fashion sketches and technical drawings digitally to visualize garment concepts, experiment with designs, and communicate ideas clearly throughout the design development process.

Textile Design

Understanding fabric properties and applying sewing techniques to construct garments with accuracy, ensuring quality craftsmanship, durability, and professional finishing in every piece.

Fashion design & Development

Producing creative fashion illustrations that showcase garment details, silhouettes, colors, and styling concepts while effectively communicating design ideas and visual narratives.

Draping

Developing garment structures directly on dress forms by manipulating fabric to explore fit, volume, silhouette, and innovative design solutions before pattern creation.

Pattern Making

Material sourcing, zero-waste pattern cutting, and lifecycle thinking for brands committed to responsible fashion practices.

Sewing

Applying garment construction techniques to assemble, finish, and refine designs while maintaining attention to detail, precision, and high-quality workmanship.

Creative Process

How I Bring Ideas to Life.

01

Research & Inspiration

Exploring fashion trends, cultural influences, visual references, and mood boards to build a strong creative foundation for every design.

02

Concept Development

Transforming ideas into sketches, silhouettes, and concepts while developing a clear design story and direction.

03

Material Selection

Experimenting with fabrics, textures, colors, and techniques to ensure each design aligns with its intended aesthetic.

04

Final Execution

Bringing concepts to life through pattern making, garment construction, fitting, refinement, and final styling.
